Apple reports fourth quarter results

CUPERTINO, CALIFORNIA — Apple today announced financial results for its fiscal 2023 fourth quarter ended September 30, 2023.

The Company posted quarterly revenue of $89.5 billion, down 1 percent year over year, and quarterly earnings per diluted share of $1.46, up 13 percent year over year.

Outlook

Management expects December quarter revenue to be similar to the year-ago quarter.

Services revenue reached an all-time high, and the installed base of active devices reached a new record in all geographic segments.
